rule.prescribed: proper readings that the Lectionary prescribes replace the weekday readings (closed list: src/utils/ordo/memorialReadings.js)
rule.alternatives: own and Common readings stay selectable where allowed
rule.route: ?option=<memorial> opens the DEFAULT readings of that option (weekday, or the proper ones when prescribed); the other groups are alternatives on the same screen

prescribed.date: Saturday after the 2nd Sunday after Pentecost
